# OS

Get the operating system of target hosts. `osapi behavior get --name os` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method get

|             |                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Description | Get the operating system of the host                                                                                                                                    |
| Detail      | Reads the distribution and its version: the ID and VERSION_ID of /etc/os-release on Linux, and darwin with the ProductVersion of sw_vers on macOS, such as darwin 15.5. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/os                                                                                                                                       |
| Permission  | os:read                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Command     | [osapi client node os get](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/os/get.md)                                                                                                 |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                                                                                                                |
| Output type | Entry                                                                                                                                                                   |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (1)

| FIELD   | TYPE   | DESCRIPTION          |
| ------- | ------ | -------------------- |
| os_info | object | The operating system |
